nexasupply_rep: Air uplift estimate (per unit): €1750 air freight + customs brokerage amendment €120 flat + handling. If we waive routing fee per earlier note, net incremental ~€14,880 for 8 units (estimate).

sam_platform: On the DOAs: are the 8 DOA units going back to Redwood as RMA returns, or being scrapped by Nexa? We need RMAs recorded to reconcile warranty.

paula_logistics_bot: BOT: FRA customs status update for AWB 125-837249 — HOLD placed 1719509980 for HS mismatch. Broker contact: +49-40-555-3344 (michael.brock@nexabroker.de).

marta_ops: Thanks. Two asks: (1) Nexa, please file HS amendment now and send broker contact to our customs agent (cc below). (2) If you can credit routing fee and expedite air on the remaining 8 for the waived fee, confirm and I'll route a PO today. Need final numbers by EOD PST.

nexasupply_rep: Filing amendment now (ref NX-AMD-17195). I'll copy our broker and your customs. We will credit the full routing fee if Redwood approves air uplift for remainder. linus_sre: If we go air, please also declare lower single-item value for customs to accelerate clearance (still within warranty valuation). Confirm you'll accept that change.

nexasupply_rep: We can declare variance down to 70% of invoice value for customs purposes; will require an indemnity from Redwood.

marta_ops: OK — send indemnity template and final invoice numbers to finance@redwood.ai. If Nexa can confirm serial list for the 8 pending as soon as they're packed, we'll approve PO for air.

nexasupply_rep: On it. Packing list for pending 8 will be with AWB for air uplift; expect pack confirmation 1719512000.
